description: Redesign all 16 user-facing templates with minimal aesthetic: remove inline styles, remove <style> blocks with complex designs, apply minimal design classes, maximize whitespace, simplify layouts, preserve all functionality/forms/links/data display, maintain template inheritance and Django template tags
steps: Redesign public/landing page (templates/public/landing.html): remove gradient hero background, simplify hero to clean centered text with generous whitespace, remove eyebrow badge animations, simplify feature cards to flat bordered cards with icon + title + description, remove card hover transforms, apply .card-minimal and .btn-minimal classes

Redesign auth pages (templates/registration/login.html, register.html, password_change.html): remove gradient background, simplify auth-card to centered .card-minimal with max-width 440px, remove logo animation, clean vertical form layout with 1.5rem spacing, apply .form-input-minimal to all inputs, apply .btn-minimal to submit buttons, preserve CSRF tokens and form field names

Redesign student dashboard (templates/student/dashboard.html): REMOVE entire <style> block with sd-shell dark theme, orbs, glassmorphism, gradients, animations; restructure to clean white background layout; simplify hero banner to flat white card with student name and basic info; convert stats cards to .card-minimal grid; simplify appointment display to clean bordered sections; remove all animated elements, pulse dots, glow effects; preserve all Django template logic ({% if %}, {% for %}, template variables)

Redesign student profile page (templates/student/profile.html): REMOVE entire <style> block with pf-shell dark theme, orbs, glassmorphism; convert to clean white background; simplify avatar to basic circle with initials (no gradients, no animated ring); convert info cards to .card-minimal; simplify form to clean vertical layout with .form-input-minimal inputs; preserve password change form and Django form widgets

Redesign other student pages: appointments.html (clean table with minimal styling), book_appointment.html (simplified booking form), chatbot.html (clean chat interface without dark theme), front_desk.html (simplified info layout) — remove any embedded <style> blocks and apply minimal classes throughout

Redesign counselor pages (templates/counselor/workspace.html, case_note.html): remove inline styles, convert to .card-minimal sections, simplify stats cards, clean table layouts for appointments, preserve all forms and action buttons with .btn-minimal, maintain encrypted case note functionality

Redesign receptionist pages (templates/receptionist/dashboard.html, booking.html): simplify 4-step booking form to clean vertical layout, remove inline styling, apply .card-minimal to main sections, clean student search results display, preserve all JavaScript functionality for student search

Redesign admin pages (templates/admin/overview.html, users.html, audit_logs.html, reports.html, profile.html): remove inline styles, convert KPI cards to .card-minimal grid, simplify chart containers, clean table layouts with minimal borders, preserve Chart.js integration, maintain all admin functionality (user management, report generation)

Update chatbot widget (templates/widgets/chatbot.html): simplify floating button design (flat circle, no gradient), clean chat panel (white background, simple border, no glassmorphism), preserve SSE streaming functionality and all JavaScript
Update messages partial (templates/partials/_messages.html): apply .alert-minimal classes, remove complex alert styling
Update all subnav partials (templates/partials/*_subnav.html): simplify navigation links to flat hover states, remove active state gradients, clean icon + text layout

Final pass: search all template files for remaining inline style attributes and <style> blocks, convert to minimal classes or remove decorative styling, ensure no template has complex visual effects, verify all forms/links/buttons remain functional
acceptance_criteria: All 16 templates redesigned with minimal aesthetic: landing, login, register, password_change, student (dashboard, appointments, book_appointment, chatbot, profile, front_desk), counselor (workspace, case_note), receptionist (dashboard, booking), admin (overview, users, audit_logs, reports, profile)
All inline style attributes removed or minimized to essential layout only
All embedded <style> blocks removed from templates (especially student/dashboard.html and student/profile.html)
Color palette limited to primary blue and neutral slate shades throughout all pages
Generous whitespace applied: 1.5-2rem spacing between sections, ample padding in cards and forms
All Django template logic preserved: {% extends %}, {% block %}, {% if %}, {% for %}, {% csrf_token %}, form fields, template variables
All functionality preserved: forms submit correctly, links navigate properly, role-based navigation works, RBAC intact
No gradients, shadows (except focus), animations, glassmorphism, or complex hover effects remain in any template
verification: Run python manage.py runserver and manually test all 16 pages:
- Public: landing page loads, clean minimal design, no console errors
- Auth: login form works, register form works, password change works
- Student: dashboard displays data, appointment booking works, profile loads, chatbot opens
- Counselor: workspace displays appointments, case notes work
- Receptionist: dashboard loads, booking form works
- Admin: overview displays metrics, user management works, audit logs display
Test responsive design at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1440px) widths → all layouts adapt cleanly
Verify WCAG contrast: primary blue (#2563EB) on white passes AA for normal text (4.5:1), slate text (#0F172A) on white passes AAA
Test keyboard navigation: all forms, buttons, and links accessible via Tab key
Verify all forms submit with CSRF tokens and proper field names
Check browser console: no CSS errors, no 404s, no JavaScript errors (except expected AI API calls if not configured)
